description_en: Queries Browser Monitoring data by using a Simple Log Service (SLS) query statement
description_zh: 根据SLS的查询语句查询前端监控的数据
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-retcode-data-by-query --pid atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf0000 --query t_:_pv_select_sum_times_as_pv_,_approx_distinct_uid_as_uv_,_date-date%3600000_as_date_group_by_date --from 1668687302 --to 1668688000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRetcodeDataByQuery

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

In the ARMS console, choose Browser Monitoring > Browser Monitoring List and click the target application name. The URL in the browser address bar contains the pid of the frontend application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the value, you need to modify the pid in the xxx%40xxx format. For example, if the pid in the URL is eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****, replace %40 with @. The actual pid is eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的前端监控 > 前端列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含前端应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，应用需要对xxx%40xxx格式的pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****，则需要将%40替换为@，即：eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.name: pid

parameters.example: t : pv|select sum(times) as pv , approx_distinct(uid) as uv , (date-date%3600000) as date  group by date
parameters.help_en: The query statement that conforms to the SLS Logstore query syntax
parameters.help_zh: 符合SLS Logstore查询语法的查询语句
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to
